description: Employee consent record (Mahdar Iqrar) for a single salary deduction. The worker acknowledges, and attaches written consent to, a specific damage / rent / fuel / custody deduction tied to a source document. Required by the Salary Deduction Policy before the deduction is posted. Submittable: a submitted, approved acknowledgment is the consent of record.

fields.description: Identity type of the consenting worker. Mirrors the native party_type / party Dynamic Link used across the housed-worker doctypes.
fields.label: Party Type

fields.description: Read-only Employee mirror of an Employee party (compatibility with payroll / Additional Salary, which is keyed on Employee).
fields.label: Employee

fields.description: Which policy deduction type this consent is for. Must match an enabled rule on the Salary Deduction Policy when the deduction is later posted.
fields.label: Deduction Type

fields.description: HRMS Salary Component (Type = Deduction) the resulting Additional Salary will use. Defaults from the policy.
fields.label: Salary Component

fields.description: Amount the worker is acknowledging. Must respect the per-type cap and the 50% combined-wage ceiling on the Salary Deduction Policy.
fields.label: Amount (SAR)

fields.description: Source DocType the deduction originates from (for example Custody Damage Assessment, Accommodation Checkout).
fields.label: Source DocType

fields.description: The specific source record (damage assessment, checkout, fuel event, custody issue) this consent applies to.
fields.label: Source Document

fields.description: Pay period date the deduction is intended to post against.
fields.label: Payroll Date

fields.description: The worker has agreed to this deduction. KSA Labor Law requires the worker's consent for this kind of wage deduction; a submitted record must carry consent and the attachment below.
fields.label: Consent Given

fields.description: Signed acknowledgment / consent document (Mahdar Iqrar) from the worker. Evidence of consent for audit and legal review.
fields.label: Consent Attachment
Consent Method
fields.options:
Signed Form
Digital Signature
Email Confirmation
Other

fields.description: Internal approval state, in addition to the worker's consent. The deduction posts only when approved.
fields.label: Approval Status

fields.description: The HRMS Additional Salary deduction generated from this acknowledgment. Populated by the controller wiring in a later increment; read-only here.
fields.label: Additional Salary Deduction

name: Employee Deduction Acknowledgment
